intro: Coorg is one of those places that stays with you long after the trip ends. Misty coffee estates in the Kodagu hills — and it is easier to plan than you might think.

sections.heading: Why visit Coorg
paragraphs: Coorg (Karnataka) is known for its hills, coffee and nature experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to March.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Mangaluru and Bengaluru are the nearest airports; Mysuru is about 3 hours by road.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Stay in a plantation homestay — the home-cooked Kodava food is the highlight.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Coorg?

faq.a: Mangaluru and Bengaluru are the nearest airports; Mysuru is about 3 hours by road.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Coorg?
faq.a: Popular choices: Madikeri for convenience; Plantation homestays; Virajpet for quieter estates.
